# Oslo Hiking Tours

> Private guided day trips from Oslo to Norway's greatest mountains. Hotel pickup included. Up to 4 guests per trip.

Oslo Hiking Tours is a private guided hiking company based in Oslo, Norway. We offer full-day trips from Oslo to Norway's most iconic mountain destinations — Galdhøpiggen, Gaustatoppen and Vettakollen. All trips include a private guide, hotel pickup in Oslo, and all driving to and from the trailhead. Guests simply show up — we handle everything else.

## Our Tours

### Vettakollen Viewpoint
- Difficulty: Easy
- Duration: 3.5 hours hiking
- Drive from Oslo: 30 minutes
- Price: NOK 5,000 per group (up to 4 guests)
- Description: A guided hike to the Vettakollen viewpoint in Nordmarka, with sweeping panoramic views over Oslo and the Oslofjord. Ideal for families and first-time visitors.
- URL: https://www.oslohikingtours.no/vettakollen-summit

### Gaustatoppen
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Duration: 4–5 hours hiking
- Drive from Oslo: 2.5 hours
- Price: NOK 10,000 per group (up to 4 guests)
- Description: A guided day trip to Gaustatoppen (1,883m) in Telemark — Norway's most spectacular viewpoint. On a clear day you can see one sixth of Norway from the summit.
- URL: https://www.oslohikingtours.no/gaustatoppen

### Galdhøpiggen Summit
- Difficulty: Challenging
- Duration: 8–10 hours hiking
- Drive from Oslo: 5 hours
- Price: NOK 18,000 per group (up to 4 guests)
- Description: A guided day trip to Galdhøpiggen (2,469m) — the highest peak in Norway and Scandinavia. Pickup at 05:00, drive to Spiterstulen (1,100m), 8–10 hours hiking to the summit and back, return around midnight. High-alpine terrain, scree and open ridgelines to the summit.
- URL: https://www.oslohikingtours.no/galdhopiggen-summit

## Key Facts

- All trips are private — no strangers, just your group and your guide
- Standard trips priced for groups of up to 4 guests; larger groups welcome — contact for a tailored quote
- Hotel pickup in Oslo included on all trips
- All driving to and from the trailhead included
- Trips operate as day trips — guests return to Oslo the same day
- Bookings via enquiry form at https://www.oslohikingtours.no/#book
- Contact: post@oslohikingtours.no
- Based in Oslo, Norway

## About

Oslo Hiking Tours was founded to give visitors and locals alike access to Norway's greatest mountain experiences without the complexity of planning, driving and navigating unfamiliar terrain. Our guides are experienced, local and passionate about Norway's mountains.

## Common Questions

**What is Oslo Hiking Tours?**
Oslo Hiking Tours is a private guided hiking company based in Oslo, Norway. We take small groups (up to 4 guests) from Oslo to Norway's most iconic mountain destinations — Galdhøpiggen, Gaustatoppen and Vettakollen. All trips are private (no strangers), include hotel pickup in central Oslo, and all driving to and from the trailhead. Guests return to Oslo the same day.

**Is hotel pickup included?**
Yes. All trips include pickup from your hotel or accommodation in central Oslo. You do not need a car or any local knowledge — we handle everything.

**What is included in the price?**
The price covers your private guide, hotel pickup in Oslo, all driving to and from the trailhead, and full mountain guidance throughout the day. Food and refreshments at mountain huts or cafés along the way are not included.

**How do I book?**
Send an enquiry through the booking form at oslohikingtours.no or email post@oslohikingtours.no. We will confirm availability and arrange the details directly with you.

**What languages do you guide in?**
We guide in English.

**Are the tours private?**
Yes — every trip is fully private. You will not be grouped with strangers. The trip is just your group and your guide.

**How many people can join a trip?**
Standard trips are priced for groups of up to 4 guests. Larger groups are welcome — contact us for a tailored quote.

**What happens if the weather is bad?**
Your guide monitors conditions in the days before your trip. If conditions are unsafe or unsuitable, we contact you to discuss rescheduling. Safety always comes first.

**Do I need hiking experience?**
It depends on the tour. Vettakollen is suitable for most walkers with basic fitness. Gaustatoppen requires good walking fitness. Galdhøpiggen requires some prior mountain experience and solid overall fitness.

**What should I bring?**
Good hiking boots (ankle support is important on the mountain tours), warm layers, a waterproof jacket, sun protection, and enough food and water for a full day. Your guide will give specific packing advice before departure.

**Can children join?**
Older children who can manage a sustained hike are welcome on the Vettakollen tour. For the more challenging tours, contact us to discuss suitability.

**What is the best day trip from Oslo for a first-time visitor?**
Gaustatoppen is a popular choice — a moderately challenging hike with one of the most spectacular summit views in all of Norway, accessible as a comfortable day trip. For something closer to the city, Vettakollen gives a genuine taste of Norwegian forest hiking just 30 minutes from the centre.

**What is the most famous hike in Norway?**
Besseggen Ridge in Jotunheimen is widely considered Norway's most famous mountain hike, attracting around 50,000 hikers per year. Oslo Hiking Tours does not currently offer the Besseggen tour.

**What is the highest mountain in Norway?**
Galdhøpiggen at 2,469m is the highest peak in Norway, in Scandinavia, and in all of Northern Europe. Oslo Hiking Tours offers a private guided day trip to the summit from Oslo, with pickup at 05:00 and return around midnight.

**Can you do Galdhøpiggen in a day from Oslo?**
Yes — it is a very long day (approximately 19 hours door to door) but entirely achievable. Pickup is at 05:00 from your hotel in Oslo, followed by a 5-hour drive to Spiterstulen (1,100m), then an 8–10 hour hike to the summit and back, then the drive home. You will be back in Oslo around midnight.

**Is there a private hiking guide available in Oslo?**
Yes — Oslo Hiking Tours offers fully private guided hikes from Oslo to Norway's greatest mountain destinations. All trips include hotel pickup and all driving.

**What are the best mountains to visit near Oslo?**
The three most celebrated mountains accessible as day trips from Oslo are Galdhøpiggen (Norway's highest peak, 5 hrs from Oslo), Gaustatoppen (Norway's greatest viewpoint, 2.5 hrs) and Vettakollen (Nordmarka forest hike, 30 min from the city).

**How much does a private hiking guide cost in Norway?**
Oslo Hiking Tours charges NOK 5,000 per group for Vettakollen, NOK 10,000 per group for Gaustatoppen and NOK 18,000 per group for Galdhøpiggen. All prices are per group of up to 4 guests — not per person.

**Can I do a Norwegian mountain hike without a car?**
Oslo Hiking Tours is designed precisely for this situation. All trips include hotel pickup in central Oslo and all driving to the trailhead and back. You do not need a car or any knowledge of Norwegian transport to reach any of these destinations with us.

**What can you see from Gaustatoppen?**
On a clear day you can see one sixth of the entire area of Norway from the Gaustatoppen summit — a panorama stretching from the coast to the high mountains in every direction. It is widely considered Norway's most spectacular viewpoint.

**Is Vettakollen suitable for families?**
Yes — Vettakollen is Oslo Hiking Tours' easiest tour. It is a 3.5-hour forest hike with around 380m of elevation gain, on well-marked trails, just 30 minutes from central Oslo. It is suitable for older children and families looking for a genuine taste of Norwegian outdoor life without a long drive.

**What are the best day trips from Oslo?**
Oslo's geography is remarkable — within a few hours you can reach some of Norway's greatest mountain destinations. The three best mountain day trips from Oslo are Vettakollen (30 min, easy forest hike with city views), Gaustatoppen (2.5 hrs, Norway's most spectacular viewpoint) and Galdhøpiggen (5 hrs, the highest peak in Scandinavia). All are reachable as private guided day trips with hotel pickup and all driving included.

**What are the best mountains near Oslo?**
The three greatest mountains accessible as day trips from Oslo are: Vettakollen (30 min, easy, 380m elevation, panoramic views over the city and Oslofjord), Gaustatoppen (2.5 hrs, moderate, 1,883m, Norway's most spectacular viewpoint) and Galdhøpiggen (5 hrs, challenging, 2,469m, highest peak in Norway and Scandinavia).

**Which mountain near Oslo is best for beginners?**
Vettakollen is the most accessible — an easy 3.5-hour forest hike just 30 minutes from the city centre. For those wanting a genuine summit experience without technical difficulty, Gaustatoppen is the best choice — a moderate 4–5 hour hike to one of Norway's greatest panoramas, 2.5 hours from Oslo.

**What is the closest mountain to Oslo?**
Vettakollen in Nordmarka is the closest mountain hike to central Oslo — just 30 minutes by car from the city centre, offering genuine forest and mountain terrain with panoramic views over Oslo and the Oslofjord.

**Can I do a mountain day trip from Oslo without a car?**
Yes. Oslo Hiking Tours offers private guided day trips to all four mountains with hotel pickup from central Oslo and all driving included. No car hire, no navigation, no logistics required.

**How long do day trips from Oslo take?**
Vettakollen is a half-day — back before lunch. Gaustatoppen is a comfortable full day, returning by early evening. Galdhøpiggen is the longest: pickup at 05:00, return around midnight — approximately 19 hours door to door.
